hooks.name: Keep protocol docs in sync
hooks.description: When protocol code changes, make sure the Chinese and English protocol docs still describe the exact bytes.

action.prompt: A protocol file under app/src/main/java/com/keepgoing/elliptical/protocol/ was saved. Compare every byte format, UUID and detection rule in the saved file with docs/PROTOCOL.md and docs/PROTOCOL.en.md. If anything changed (a command frame, checksum, characteristic, detection order, resistance table), update both documents so they match the code, and keep the decompiled-source reference for each fact. If nothing protocol-related changed, do nothing.
